## Problem and bounded outcome

Describe the user-visible behavior and why existing functionality is insufficient.

## Acceptance and dependencies

List executable success/failure checks, selected primary tools, official support
and advisory references, architecture/resource/privilege requirements.

## Safety and teardown

Identify owned resources, explicit execution boundary, secrets handling and
cleanup. Cloud, paid services, host changes and registry publishing require
separate authorization.

## Claims and evidence

What status is appropriate until the checks actually run? Keep unsupported
platforms and proposed production improvements separate.
